evidence.why: Proves implemented behavior, not why platform teardown is unnecessary.
Proves the shutdown role and conditional remaining cleanup.

reason: Retain observed no-op shutdown role but remove the unsupported causal claim that the platform requires no teardown: an empty implementation does not establish platform requirements.

evidence.why: Complete TU implements only a side-effect-free return.
Establishes cleanup ordering and conditional console callback.

reason: The sole routine is a no-op platform cleanup interface. Canonical exit invokes it after internal exit callbacks, outside the non-aborting cleanup guard, then conditionally runs and clears the console hook before _ExitProcess. Existing descriptions fit this flow; console cleanup is conditional, not guaranteed.
